title: iOS UI uses short copy, icons, and subtle native motion
summary: Prefer icon/image + clear short labels over long explanatory prose on iOS surfaces. Motion is native SwiftUI, subtle and atmospheric — not forced or web-style (no GSAP on native). Brand identity must be recognizable across screens.
rationale: Operator: 'People dont like seeing long long prose on the ios app, icon, image and clear text is what is prefered' and 'animation should not feel forced yet beautiful'.
situation: Prototype screens used paragraph-length copy and over-animated motion.
